# Zscaler EMAIL DLP overview — ASIM parity

Normalized Zscaler Internet Access telemetry delivered exclusively through Cribl. Lineage: `Azure/Azure-Sentinel` commit `cd455a8cecf3e5e983f9cd08191dca3d211c9fa1`, `Solutions/Zscaler Internet Access/Workbooks/NSSEmailDLPLogs.json`. Vendor-specific values are read from documented `AdditionalFields` keys; select a time range and workspace below.

content.query:
_Im_FileEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSEmaildlplog'
| extend EventClassId=coalesce(EventOriginalType,tostring(AdditionalFields['EventClassId']))
| where EventClassId =~ 'DLP Incident'
| extend RuleLabel=coalesce(tostring(AdditionalFields['DlpRule']),'Unknown rule')
| summarize Incidents=count() by bin(TimeGenerated,1h), RuleLabel
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: DLP incidents over time by DLP rule (trend chart)

content.query:
_Im_FileEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSEmaildlplog'
| extend EventClassId=coalesce(EventOriginalType,tostring(AdditionalFields['EventClassId']))
| where EventClassId =~ 'DLP Incident'
| summarize TotalIncidents=count() by SourceUserName=ActorUsername
| top 10 by TotalIncidents desc
content.title: Top senders generating DLP incidents

content.query:
_Im_FileEvent
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler'
| where EventProduct has 'ZIA'
| where tostring(AdditionalFields['LogType']) =~ 'NSSEmaildlplog'
| extend EventClassId=coalesce(EventOriginalType,tostring(AdditionalFields['EventClassId']))
| where EventClassId =~ 'DLP Incident'
| extend DlpDictionary=coalesce(tostring(AdditionalFields['DlpDictionary']),'Unknown dictionary'), FileType=coalesce(TargetFileExtension,tostring(AdditionalFields['AttachmentFileType']),'Unknown')
| summarize Incidents=count() by DlpDictionary,FileType
| order by Incidents desc
content.title: DLP incidents by dictionary/policy and attachment file type
